I made a "basic bitch" tool stand. (pics in comments)

Needed something to keep my most frequently used tools handy and some space next to my mill for leaving stuff around so i slapped together something from wood.

I figured i would try a combination of dowels and screws so i don't have to wait for glue to finish drying and don't have to deal with large vice grips since i didn't have mine handy.

Made a simple doweling jig from aluminum first: https://i.imgjar.co/jar/NFuUn7IQNkGkTWuhpoqvXw.jpg

Most peaces put together: https://i.imgjar.co/jar/pPpAHkxHmUizjX_ar0DHng.jpg

Two legs and two straight wheels underneath: https://i.imgjar.co/jar/6BOPMfMbs0mA_4VupWZf5Q.jpg

Bolts visible from the back (there is a dowel in between every visible bolt): https://i.imgjar.co/jar/Zbv37ZSqskO-Y863AgIu5A.jpg

The hole through the back board is just for the hand so pulling it around is easier. In hind site, the dowel/screw combo might have took more time than it was worth it, think next time i would stick to one or the other.

 

Finished product after oil coat: https://i.imgjar.co/jar/s-NYjpVzqkqRwxIWZitj3A.jpg

Partially populated with tools: https://i.imgjar.co/jar/GSgHI3T49kKj3Zns9H-bJw.jpg

Tools hanging just from simple stainless screws like this: http://pop.h-cdn.co/assets/16/41/torx.jpg

 

Ran a halogen lamp and 0-100% dimmer in the top portion: https://i.imgjar.co/jar/S5swUVY8ZEGtylTc0BhxYQ.jpg

Its comfy looking at night, especially when dimmed lower than 100%. Also has power outlets on the side.
